scripts.ideaTitle: How to Style an Oversized Shirt 3 Ways
scripts.hook: One oversized shirt. Three completely different outfits.
slides: 01 / THE LAZY LAYER. Wear it completely unbuttoned over a fitted white ribbed tank, paired with straight-leg trousers and clean white sneakers. Effortless.
02 / THE SHARP CONTRAST. Button it all the way up, tuck it into pleated black trousers, and add a minimalist leather belt and silver watch. Clean business-casual.
03 / THE TEXTURE PLAY. Layer it underneath a cropped zip-up jacket or leather bomber, letting the curved hem peek out at the bottom.
scripts.caption:
Maximizing your wardrobe is all about versatility. One good shirt is worth ten mediocre ones. Rate this fit 1-10! 🔥
